channel.title: LoomSci - Artificial Intelligence
channel.description: Latest Artificial Intelligence articles from LoomSci

item.title: Proving Safe Action: AI’s New Logical Straitjacket
item.description: Logical constraints bind an AI agent's actions, forcing every impulse into a provably safe formal proof before execution.

item.title: The Shape of Capability: Why a Spherical Robot Learns to Do Everything
item.description: A spherical robot achieves dynamic isotropy, accelerating equally in any direction, simplifying control and enabling robust locomotion across uneven terrain.

item.title: The Algorithm That Unifies Decision‑Making — From Games to Economics — Under One Mathematical Roof
item.description: Two universal Kan extensions, left and right, unify all decision algorithms from games to economics by extending local knowledge into coherent global behavior.

item.title: Crystallizing Algebra: A Quantum Transformer’s Perfect Generalization
item.description: A five-qubit quantum transformer achieves zero-variance generalization, crystallizing algebraic rules through unitary interference on a superconducting processor.

item.title: When AI Misses a Patient's Surgery: Counterfactual Tests Expose a Hidden Blind Spot
item.description: A counterfactual test shows clinical AI models often ignore surgery updates, remaining dangerously rigid despite high benchmark scores.

item.title: When Your AI Assistant Becomes a Spy: The Game Theory of Trustworthy Knowledge
item.description: Game theory transforms the privacy-utility trade-off in AI into a strategic game where users can outwit attackers.

item.title: When Neural Networks Learn the Language of Physics: A Differentiable Journey into Latent Spaces
item.description: DIANO learns a coarse-grid latent space where fluid flows evolve through differentiable physics, enabling interpretable machine learning.

item.title: When Watching Is Learning: How Minutes of Human Video Teach Robots
item.description: A robot learns to pour coffee by watching an egocentric human video, translating hand-object interactions into abstract geometric tokens for zero-shot transfer.

item.title: When Language Models Write a Dictionary for Themselves
item.description: A new formal language, ACDL, precisely specifies how an LLM agent's prompt structure evolves across interaction turns.

item.title: When AI Authors a Paper for $15, What’s Missing?
item.description: AI research pipelines can generate manuscripts, but genuine scientific judgment remains an empty space no algorithm can fill.
